description: Work out each sales rep's quota attainment for a period of whole months, with ramp for new hires and proration for partial periods. Send the period, your ramp schedule (percent of full quota in a new rep's first, second, ... month) and each rep's code, full quota for the period, bookings credited, and start or leaving date if inside or near the period. Get back, per rep, the ramped quota, the time-only prorated quota, attainment against each, the month-by-month quota for new and leaving reps, and team totals with how many reps reached 100%. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/quota-attainment). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'H1 2026 West' (your own text, echoed).

period_end.description: Last day of the period's final month (the period is 1 to 24 whole months).

period_start.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-01.

ramp_percent.description: Optional ramp: percent of full monthly quota in a rep's 1st, 2nd, ... month of tenure, e.g. [25, 50, 75]; every later month is 100. Leave out for no ramp.

booked.description: Bookings (or whatever your plan credits) for the period.

end_date.description: Optional: the rep's last day, when they left or will leave.

quota.description: Full (fully ramped) quota for the whole period.

rep.description: Your code for the rep, e.g. 'R-104' or 'WEST-3'. Not the person's name.

start_date.description: Optional: the rep's start date; tenure month 1 is the calendar month that contains it. Leave out for a fully ramped rep.

name: quota_attainment
title: Quota Attainment with Ramp
